# Gold (XAU/USD) briefing — None SGT

Price is $4379.0, -20.7 (-0.47%) compared with yesterday's close of 4399.7.
Current read: NEUTRAL. Gold is going sideways — nothing is pushing it hard either way. Because it's -0.47% compared with where it finished yesterday, and in the last hour it's been going up (+0.19%), and today's headlines are evenly split (1 good, 1 bad).
Today's range: low $4278.9 to high $4392.8. Price is 88% of the way up that range ($100.1 above the low, $13.8 below the high).
Trading sessions open right now: New York. Next: New York closes in 123 minutes.
Measured from the last two days of 1-minute data, gold moves most in these hours (SGT): 20:00 (4.1 pips/min), 21:00 (3.9 pips/min), 22:00 (3.6 pips/min).
Related markets today: US dollar index 100.215 (-0.01%), US 10-year yield 4.998 (+1.03%), Silver 67.149 (+1.59%).
The US dollar is basically flat today, so it is not the thing pushing gold around right now.

Things that do not line up (these are usually the real story):
  - Gold and silver are diverging: silver +1.59% vs gold -0.47%. They normally move together, so this gap is unusual.
  - Gold moved -0.47% while the dollar barely moved (-0.01%). So whatever moved gold today was not the dollar.
